rows.title: Design → Line Height saves values like 1.4000000000000001, and clicking into the box shows that long number instead of 1.4
rows.summary: Now: Line Height's − / + buttons and a typed value store a clean number. − from 1.5 stores 1.4, and typing 1.4 then Enter stores 1.4, so the focused box and the JSON export show 1.4, not 1.4000000000000001. The fix is in NumberRow (src/components/DesignPanelShared.jsx). One snap() helper rounds Math.round(n / step) * step to the step's decimals (step 0.1 gives 1 decimal, step 1 gives 0). The typed commit and both buttons use it. Rows with a whole-number step are unchanged. Nothing that prints changes, because the layout already read the same value.
rows.remaining: Values already saved with float error (e.g. 1.4000000000000001) are not migrated. The next − / + or typed value on that row stores a clean one. The Website-field freeze lead did not reproduce (see the hunter's note) and was not pursued.
